name: Reminders for WooCommerce
author: yosikrivo

sections.description:
Reminders for WooCommerce adds a complete reminder management system directly to your WooCommerce orders page. Perfect for store managers who need to track follow-ups, special requests, shipping notes, or any order-related tasks.

Key Features

  • Quick Reminder Creation – Add reminders with one click from the orders page
  • Rich Notes – Add detailed notes to each reminder
  • Visual Management – Clean, modern interface that integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce
  • Archive System – Mark reminders as completed and keep them archived for reference
  • Bulk Actions – Manage multiple reminders at once
  • Search & Filter – Quickly find the reminder you need
  • No Configuration Needed – Works immediately after activation

Perfect For

  • Following up on pending orders
  • Tracking special customer requests
  • Managing shipping exceptions
  • Remembering to check payment confirmations
  • Noting items that need special handling
  • Keeping track of customer communications

Privacy Policy

This plugin stores reminder data locally in your WordPress database. No data is sent to external servers.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please use the WordPress.org support forum.

Credits

Developed by Yosi Krivo
Icons by Dashicons (WordPress)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/reminders-for-woocommerce directory, or install through the WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Orders to see the reminder buttons in the toolbar
  4. Click “NEW REMINDER” to create your first reminder

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.3 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes! The plugin is fully compatible with both the traditional posts storage and the new HPOS system.

Can I add reminders to specific orders?

Currently, reminders are general and not tied to specific orders. This feature is planned for a future update.

Is there a limit to how many reminders I can create?

No, you can create unlimited reminders.

Can multiple users share reminders?

Yes, all users with WooCommerce management permissions can view and manage reminders.

Will my reminders be deleted if I deactivate the plugin?

No, your reminders are safely stored in the database and will be available when you reactivate the plugin.

Are there advanced features available?

Yes. There is a separate commercial add-on (outside WordPress.org) that provides advanced features such as categories, date-based reminders, and email notifications.
